name: Hillend Camping Park
accommodation: 240 pitches (100 with electric hook-up) plus lodges
suitableFor: Campers, families and groups wanting to be right by the beach
beachAccess: About 200 yards from the beach at the northern end of Rhossili Bay (Llangennith end)
confirmedFeatures: Free hot showers, laundrette, shop, children's adventure playground, recreation field, phone charging, Eddy's Cafe-Bar
overview: Hillend sits behind the dunes at the Llangennith end of Rhossili Bay, around 200 yards from the sand. It is a big, well-equipped site with 240 pitches, lodges, a shop and its own licensed cafe-bar, Eddy's. Several independent surf schools run from the main car park.
surfTripFit: You can walk from your tent to the surf at Llangennith, and surf schools operate from the site's own car park.
